name: io.github.MaxEllis/orcaslicer-mcp
description: Work a running OrcaSlicer with AI: slice, tune, and understand what each setting costs

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Remote API token from the OrcaSlicer MCP build (Preferences -> Remote API)

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: OrcaSlicer Remote API address; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:13130

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_MCP_ALLOW_KEYS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated config keys the MCP may change even though they run code or drive the printer directly (post_process, *_gcode, print host settings). Blank by default.
